heading: Combination matrix
text:
## Combination matrix [LCAP.5]

The combinations of the five settings with engine consequences for cost —
`realtime`, `constspace`, `linear_scan`, `logical` and `dynamic_ttl`
([LCAP.2]). Of their 32 combinations, the 8 with `realtime: true` and
`constspace: false` violate [LCAP.3.7]; the 24 others are listed. This
edition admits only the 8 with both `realtime` and `constspace` `false`
([LCAP.2.1.5]); the matrix states the algebra of the settings, not what
this edition admits.
Properties:
- **Alloc-free**: zero `malloc`/`realloc` in pump after go_live
- **Join O(1)**: J_max=1 proven; no left/right memory scan. The bound is
  [LNLS.5.1]'s, which does not bind this edition; its engine meets [LNLS.5.8]
- **No TMS**: TMS not allocated; no cascade
- **TTL O(1)**: the TTL tick has no term in N_ttl; its one log factor is in
  the number of TTL schemas, which is fixed at compile time ([LCAP.3.3]). Whether the tick's total is a compile-time constant
  depends on a bounded `N_max` ([LDTL.7.1]), which is the T_wcet column's
  question and footnote ¹'s. The bound is [LDTL.6.3]'s, which does not bind
  this edition; its engine meets [LDTL.6.4]
- **String O(1)**: all string ops bounded by `capacity`
- **T_wcet fixed**: the entire formula evaluates to a single number from the
  program and its declared bounds ([LCAP.4])
- **Alpha-only**: no beta network (single-pattern rules only)

| `realtime` | `constspace` | `linear_scan` | `logical` | `dynamic_ttl` | Alloc-free | Join O(1) | No TMS | TTL O(1) | String O(1) | T_wcet fixed | Alpha-only |

| false | false | true | true | false | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ | ✗ | ✗¹ | ✗ |
| false | false | true | true | true | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ | ✗² | ✗ | ✗¹ | ✗ |
| false | false | true | false | false | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ | ✗ | ✗¹ | ✗ |

| false | false | false | false | false | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✗¹ | **✓** |
| false | false | false | false | true | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ | ✗² | ✓ | ✗¹ | **✓** |
| false | true | true | true | false | ✓³ | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ | ✗ | ✗¹ | ✗ |
| false | true | true | true | true | ✓³ | ✗ | ✗ | ✗² | ✗ | ✗¹ | ✗ |

| false | true | false | false | false | ✓³ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✗¹ | **✓** |
| false | true | false | false | true | ✓³ | ✓ | ✓ | ✗² | ✓ | ✗¹ | **✓** |
| true | true | true | true | false | ✓ | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ | ✗ | ✓⁴ | ✗ |
| true | true | true | true | true | ✓ | ✗ | ✗ | ✗² | ✗ | ✓⁴ | ✗ |
| true | true | true | false | false | ✓ | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ | ✗ | ✓⁴ | ✗ |
| true | true | true | false | true | ✓ | ✗ | ✓ | ✗² | ✗ | ✓⁴ | ✗ |
| true | true | false | true | false | ✓ | ✓ | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✗ |
| true | true | false | true | true | ✓ | ✓ | ✗ | ✗² | ✓ | ✓⁴ | ✗ |

| true | true | false | false | true | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✗² | ✓ | ✓⁴ | **✓** |

¹ Not fixed without `realtime`, on every row that lacks it. Without it `N_max` is unbounded, so `T_wcet`
  cannot be computed to a number even when every per-operation cost is O(1).
  `constspace` does **not** lift this: it bounds the pools, so `N_max` is
  bounded under it, but `[LCSP.3.1]` declines a WCET claim outright — pump
  time is unbounded because expression depth, RHS action-sequence length and
  series-backend behaviour are unbounded under `constspace` alone. A bounded
  `N_max` is necessary for a fixed `T_wcet` and not sufficient.

² `dynamic_ttl: true` reintroduces O(expired × log N_ttl) in the TTL tick,
  removing the O(1) TTL guarantee, on every row that has it. Under `realtime`
  with `linear_scan: false` the compiler should warn ([LCAP.3.9]).

³ **Alloc-free under `constspace` without `realtime` is the pooled
  guarantee, not the total one.** `[LCSP.2.1]` binds assert, pump and fire to
  pools sized at boot, and names three paths that sit outside it: the
  string-intern table, which `constspace` cannot freeze because it has no
  `go_live` to freeze at ([LCSP.3.5]); series identity cardinality, which the
  event trace drives and nothing caps ([LCSP.3.6]); and a `String`-typed
  series, rejected outright for that reason ([LCSP.4.5]). The column's own
  definition above says *after go_live* — a milestone these rows do not have.
  Where `realtime` is also present the guarantee is the unqualified one and
  the mark is plain ✓.

⁴ **Fixed, but not O(1) in `N_max`.** `realtime` bounds every parameter
  ([LCAP.4]), so the formula still evaluates to a number. Some terms in it
  grow with the bounds:
  - with `linear_scan: true`, a join may scan, at `N_max × T_j` ([LCAP.2.1]);
  - with `linear_scan: true`, a string test costs up to the longest interned
    string. The intern table is locked ([RTCT.12.4]), so that length is known
    once the program loads, but not when it compiles;
  - with `dynamic_ttl: true`, the TTL tick is the deadline heap's
    O(expired × log N_ttl) ([LCAP.3.3]).

  Only the rows with plain ✓ have a `T_wcet` that is O(1) in `N_max`.

alloy.name: lcap_5__columns
alloy.note: The clause prints cells, not column rules; each rule here is a clause's, and none rests on the rows: alloc-free LCAP.2.6; join O(1) and string O(1) LCAP.2.2 with LCAP.4; no TMS LCAP.2.3; TTL O(1) LCAP.2.4 and LDTL.1.1 with LCAP.3.3; T_wcet fixed LCAP.4's realtime row with the column's own definition; alpha-only LCAP.3.1.

alloy.name: lcap_5__footnotes
alloy.note: Each footnote is placed by its own first sentence, on every row that has the cause: 1 without realtime, 2 with dynamic_ttl, 3 with constspace and not realtime, 4 with realtime and linear_scan or dynamic_ttl. Footnote 2's second sentence, the warning under realtime and linear_scan false, is LCAP.3.9's and places no mark.
